# Auris Hotel Lounge

> This shisha lounge sits within a five-star hotel in Al Barsha 1, a five-minute walk from Mall of the Emirates in Dubai. The property has 337 rooms and suites, an outdoor swimming pool and a fitness centre, and now trades as the Elite Byblos Hotel, having previously been known as the Auris Plaza Hotel and the Coral Dubai Al Barsha. The lounge serves a range of shisha flavours.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Al Barsha, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project involved a hookah lounge at the Auris hotel in Al Barsha, a busy hospitality district close to Mall of the Emirates in Dubai. The property has since been rebranded as the Elite Byblos Hotel. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the lounge, delivering the building services required for a comfortable hospitality venue within the hotel.
